tasks.label: Run Flask website (local SQLite)
args: import os; [os.environ.pop(k, None) for k in ('DB_HOST', 'DB_USER', 'DB_PASSWORD', 'DB_NAME', 'DB_PORT', 'DB_SSL_CA')]; os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = 'sqlite:///instance/users.sqlite3'; import app; app.app.run(host='127.0.0.1', port=5000, debug=False)
